description: Reads the EISA requirements workbook (.xlsx attached to the run) into JSON rows: finds the requirements sheet by its headers, marks each row assess / prefilled / notApplicable / outOfScope / heading, and keeps a copy of the workbook for EISA: write workbook. Standard library only.

params.label: Workbook
params.description: Absolute path, or a file name in the run's extras/ folder. Empty: the first .xlsx attached to the run.

params.label: System types
params.description: Comma-separated Applicability values of the assessed system, e.g. 'Web Application, Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)'. Empty: a 'System types:' line in the task, else every row applies.

params.label: Requirements in scope
params.description: Comma-separated EISA ids or families to assess, e.g. 'ACC-301, OPS-401, ACQ-205'. Empty: a 'Requirements:' line in the task, else every row. Rows outside stay untouched.

params.label: Keep pre-filled rows
params.description: Rows that already have Implemented or Rationale are left as they are.

params.label: Implemented values
params.description: Allowed values besides blank; checked by EISA: check answers, added to the dropdown by EISA: write workbook.
